page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, this instance provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading, ensuring consistent performance for demanding workloads.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, translating to a high resource density of 9.6 GB of RAM per core. This memory-heavy configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps to facilitate rapid data transfer. There is no bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external block storage volumes. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

Given its high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require large in-memory datasets but do not need local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and intensive data processing applications that benefit from high memory capacity and dedicated Intel Xeon processing power.
